# MET

> MET is a free app for iPhone and Android that shows where in the world your friends live. Users pin each friend in the city they live in on a world map, and save how they met, birthday, nationality, notes and contact details (phone, email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Snapchat, Facebook).

Key facts:
- Free download; MET Premium (weekly subscription or one-time lifetime purchase) adds iCloud sync on iPhone or Google Drive sync on Android, and backup and restore.
- No account, no ads, no tracking. Data is stored on the user's phone. MET never uses GPS or live location; users choose where each friend lives.
- Friends can share their profile as a QR code; scanning it adds them with details filled in.
- Countries with friends are shaded on the map, with a count of friends and countries.
